sentences.text:
Shri Nitin Agrawal - Advocate for the respondent No.2.
 Order

The present petition, under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India, has been filed by the petitioner seeking the following reliefs:
"i) The order dated 13.06.2016 Annexure P/9 may kindly be quashed.

ii) The respondents may kindly be directed to issue a formal order of de-notification/exclusion of land situated in survey No.303/2 of village Chirwai,
Distt. Gwalior ad-measuring 2.5 Bigha from the residential scheme known as "Mahadji Nagar Awasiya Yojna" from the notification Annexure P/1 by publishing it in a gazette notification.
iii) That, in the alternative the respondent No. 2 may kindly be directed to acquire the land in question in terms of"the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10109 2 WP-8128-2016 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013" if they are in need of the same.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Any other suitable direction which this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the facts and circumstances of the case may kindly be passed."

At the outset, learned counsel for respondent No.2 submits that the land of the petitioner bearing Survey No.303/2, ad-measuring 2.5 bigha situated at Village Chirwai, District Gwalior has been de-notified by the State Government under Section 52 (1) 'ga' read with Section 52 (1) ' kha' of Madhya Pradesh Nagar Tatha Gram Nivesh Adhiniyam, 1973 from Mahadji Nagar Residential Scheme of the Gwalior Development Authority vide letter/communication dated 12.04.2022 issued by the Chief Executive Officer, Gwalior Development Department, Gwalior and accordingly, the land in question has been revoked to the petitioners.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It was thus submitted that the present petition has rendered infructuous.

In the wake of categorical statements made by counsel for the respondent No.2, which has not been controverted by the counsel for the petitioners, nothing survives in the present petition to be adjudicated further.
Therefore, the present petition is disposed of as infructuous.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE pwn*
